---CRITIQUE Sales-Scaled R&D Cash Harvest---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a cosmetic re-parameterization of the archive's "Lagged R&D Cash Harvest" (same two legs, with the deflator switched from assets to sales and windows nudged from 3 to 5), so it tests no new economic mechanism and its first leg is essentially the well-known R&D-to-sales intensity anomaly.

---CRITIQUE Brand Spend Cash Persistence---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The advertising-stock-only leg is genuinely new relative to the archive's xrd+xad blends and the mean-minus-vol cash-margin quality leg is coherently signed, though COALESCE(xad,0) creates a large mass point of non-reporters that will make the first-leg rank partly a reporting-status dummy and the advertising level effect itself is close to published brand-capital results.

---CRITIQUE Knowledge Depreciation Mix---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The xrd/(xrd+dp) investment-mix ratio is a genuinely different construct from the intensity ratios already tested and is well matched to the stated hypothesis, but the second leg is little more than a cash-margin profitability sort (a known anomaly) and the mix ratio is undefined/degenerate when both xrd and dp are near zero.

---CRITIQUE R&D Earnings Absorption---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Structurally this is the archive's top-performing "Stable Cash R&D Flywheel" with ib substituted for oancf, and it is internally inconsistent/mechanical: R&D is added into the level numerator but excluded from the volatility term, so high-R&D firms are mechanically pushed up on both legs and the interaction double-counts the same variable.

---CRITIQUE Debt-Funded Goodwill Decay---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A defensible diagnosis-driven repair of the failed static-goodwill signal (level to increment, total liabilities to interest-bearing debt) with signs consistent throughout, though rising goodwill plus rising debt is largely a repackaging of the asset-growth/acquirer-underperformance anomaly and DELTA(gdwl) is zero for most firm-months.

---CRITIQUE R&D Abandonment Cash Squeeze---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: R&D contraction conditioned on prior research commitment and deteriorating cash generation is a substantively new mechanism in this archive (previous R&D-decline tests were absent) and the triple rank product is correctly signed, with the main risk being noise and compressed dispersion from multiplying three ranks.
